{{Quote|This is obviously an act of terrorism. What did the Republic do to stop this? Where are our Jedi? That's it for Tynna. I'll be contacting Count Dooku once we can establish new government headquarters somewhere.|Razelfiin|<ref name="HNNews" />}}
'''Razelfiin''' was a [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]]<ref name="CSWETyn" /> and leader of her [[Species/Legends|people]] on<ref name="HNNews" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]]<ref name="HNNews" /> shortly before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|onset]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="CSWE" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after her election by lottery, the [[Tynna Central Government Building]] in [[Lutris]] collapsed<ref name="HNNews" /> due to a [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mite]] infestation.<ref name="CSWE" /> He<ref name="CSWETyn" /> attributed the collapse to a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] attack and, angered by a lack of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] intervention, she subsequently declared her intention to contact<ref name="HNNews" /> [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Head of State/Legends|leader]]<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] as soon as she could procure a new building from which to govern.<ref name="HNNews" /> Razelfiin eventually pushed Tynna into the Confederacy,<ref name="CSWE" /> but the planet rejoined the Republic before the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the Clone Wars<ref name="CSWETyn" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Razelfiin first appeared in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 53|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #53'']], an article on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] website<ref name="HNNews" /> in [[2002]].<ref name="HNNews date">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News &mdash; A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News &mdash; A Galaxy Divided}}</ref> While the article describes Razelfiin as using she/her pronouns,<ref name="HNNews" /> the entry in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' gives Razelfiin's pronouns as he/him.<ref name="CSWETyn" />
